title: Pretext: It uses pure JavaScript and arithmetic to measure text, completely bypassing the DOM
description:
This new project has just sparked a discussion on X and Reddit about the future of web development. For twenty years, we've let CSS handle text layout. But complex animations cause massive performance lag. Meet Pretext! It throws CSS completely out the window. It uses pure JavaScript and arithmetic to measure text, completely bypassing the DOM. The result? Insane sixty-frames-per-second fluid text animations with zero layout lag!

https://github.com/chenglou/pretext
